== Biography ==

Mary Ann is a person known to the White Rabbit. The White Rabbit addresses her by name when he requires assistance, directing her to fetch items such as a pair of white kid gloves and a fan. She appears to be someone associated with his household, though the exact nature of this association remains unclear.
